Investor financial data is visible only to vetted investors. Auditors read everything and change nothing.
5 · THE ENGINE — already built, tested, invisible to users
PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.5. The rules live here because application code gets rewritten and the rules must survive that.

OPEN — needs the client before launch
1 EU emblem asset + exact disclaimer wording from the grant agreement (renders as a red placeholder until supplied)
2 Public record still carries sector + country + size on every row. Per-deal labels no longer link a buyer's deals, but those three
attributes still match a named row to a pseudonymous one. Needs a k-anonymity rule - suppress below a minimum buyer count.
3 Availability: expected / buffer / reserved / committed / remaining are mutually determining. With one buyer, committed IS their volume.
Options: publish committed in bands, suppress below a threshold, or accept it. Product decision, not an engineering one.
4 Evidence pack needs a budget (note section 6) but budgets are investor-only. Decide which figure goes in and who may download it.
5 May a registered but NOT YET vetted buyer add sites? Recommended yes - sites are private and it helps them decide whether to apply.
6 Auditors and erasure: does the grant agreement require retaining named individuals for a fixed period? That would override erasure.
7 Demo-data notice needs a removal plan for launch. 8 Co-investor claim rights on volume sold onward - one buyer said this decides participation.
payments · escrow · settlement · an official credit registry · automatic legal or environmental claims · public comments · public buyer identities by default · cross-project unit totals
